description:
The gf2-core crate guides and benchmark result notes served as fact sources for the permanent pages. Once mined, they leave the crate and are preserved in the legacy mirror.

## Background

Inbound citations include the crate README, Rustdoc in `src/field/winograd.rs` and `src/field/expr.rs`, bench headers and several `dev/active/` documents (`dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/investigation.md` §3.5).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `crates/gf2-core/docs/` and the Markdown notes under `crates/gf2-core/benches/` live under `dev/archive/legacy/<original-relative-path>`, moved with history preserved, and the original paths no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each inbound citation outside the mirror points to the permanent page covering the topic, to the mirror path, or is removed as design-history provenance; digest-pinned machine inputs keep their bytes.
- [hard] REQ-03: A link scan of the touched files reports no unresolved local link, and the Rust CI gate passes.
- [hard] REQ-04: The manifest records each row as complete.

## Decisions

- DEC-01: The owner ruled on 2026-10-04 that digest-pinned machine inputs keep their bytes (REQ-02 carries the amendment), and that the descriptions of terminal tracker issues are historical records that keep their text: a path of a moved file inside such a description is outside REQ-02.
title: Move gf2-core crate guides into the legacy mirror
